metrics.uncommenced_leases: Signed leases that have not yet commenced. Under ASC 842 a lease is not recognised until the lessor makes the asset available, so these sit in the footnotes only.
metrics.purchase_commitments: Non-cancelable purchase / supply / unconditional purchase obligations disclosed in the commitments footnote.

provenance.filing: Figure quoted directly from the filing's footnote text or commitments table.
provenance.filing_table: Figure from the filing's maturity table; the year-by-year rows sum to the stated total (arithmetic check passed).
provenance.press: Figure reported by financial press citing the filing; not independently re-read.
provenance.derived: Approximate, inferred from a reported change or ratio. Treat as indicative.

meta.collection_note: SEC.gov and every filing mirror were unreachable from the build environment (egress policy blocked all hosts except GitHub). Figures were collected by searching filing text. Each observation carries its provenance; gaps are left empty rather than estimated.

series_notes.NVDA_uncommenced_leases: NVIDIA does not disclose a material 'leases not yet commenced' balance. Its off-balance-sheet exposure sits in supply and capacity purchase obligations instead, so this series is empty by disclosure, not by omission.
series_notes.ORCL_early: Oracle only began disclosing a large uncommenced-lease balance in fiscal 2026; earlier quarters carried immaterial amounts.
series_notes.reconciliation_ms_1q26: Morgan Stanley counted $982bn of purchase commitments across the six at 31 Mar 2026. This dataset totals $945.8bn for the same date. Five of six agree to the rounding: GOOGL 332.4 vs 332, MSFT 142 vs 142, META 237.7 vs 238, AMZN 103.8 vs 104, ORCL 11 vs 11. The whole $36bn gap is NVIDIA, where this dataset carries the $119bn disclosed for the quarter ended 26 Apr 2026 and Morgan Stanley used $155bn - most likely NVIDIA's fiscal year-end (25 Jan 2026) figure on a broader definition that folds in other purchase obligations and cloud service agreements. Substituting 155 gives $981.8bn.
series_notes.reconciliation_leases: The 2026Q2 uncommenced-lease total here is $1,090bn, against press reporting of roughly $1.09tn of not-yet-started data-centre leases across big tech. The two are close but not the same population, so treat the agreement as corroboration rather than a match.
series_notes.definitions: The six filers do not use one definition. Alphabet reports 'purchase commitments and other contractual obligations'; Microsoft a contractual-obligations 'purchase commitments' line; Meta 'non-cancelable contractual commitments'; Amazon 'unconditional purchase obligations'; NVIDIA 'purchase commitments and supply obligations'; Oracle 'unconditional purchase and certain other obligations'. Totals across companies are therefore indicative, not like-for-like.
